text: sadly my dog is a big chewer, and even though he is 15 pounds, and this was marked for large dogs, he can consume one of the bully sticks or pigs ears in about 10 minutes.  so as much fun as this subscription was, I had to cancel as it won't last as long as I was hoping for him., and I was nervous giving to a larger dog, as they may try to eat the whole thing in bigger bites.
